sources.quote: Beta Pegasi, formally named Scheat, is a red giant star and the second-brightest star in the constellation of Pegasus.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 1,864 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,541 K, so 114.864 solar radii.
